messages:
incident-bot: [CRITICAL] hosted-api-us-east: p99 latency 11.8s, request_queue=15,200, gpu-pool-us-east saturation. Autoscaler errors spike. Paging: @sre-amy @rohit-oncall

sre-amy: on it. joining call. quick snapshot? customer impact?

support-maria: gateway 502/504 and 429 spikes. ~7.9% error-rate last 4m. Affected: ad-campaigns-proxy, search-preview, preview-api. Customers reporting timeouts. Dashboard -> https://logs.redwood/internal/stream/998001/logs

eng-runtime-dan: autoscaler logs: multiple CreateInstance -> cloud API 429/QuotaExceeded (RateLimitExceeded). Desired replicas 50, actual 29. Backoff escalated. KV cache miss-rate rising, mem usage at 96%.

infra-jen: gpu nodes: mem 98% on several, NVML shows multiple minor OOM events. Provisioner queue length growing; cloud provider api_rate_limit_errors=420 in last 6m. Manual creates also throttled.

sre-amy: triage plan (short): 1) route non-critical tenants to cpu-fallback; 2) emergency per-tenant throttles for top noisy tenants; 3) try manual reserved nodes in a different AZ/region; 4) reduce KV/prefix cache footprint. Start 1+2 now.

eng-runtime-dan: applying cpu fallback for noncritical routes: `rbac route-set --env hosted --match '/v1/preview' --fallback model-compact-cpu-v2 --scope noncritical-tenants` (rolling). Also enabling streaming chunk-size to 256 tokens to lower peak memory per request.

rohit-oncall: pushing tenant throttles now for top noisy tenants: `POST /controlplane/rate_limit {tenant: "ad-campaigns-proxy", qps: 40}` then cascade to others. Expect immediate drop in queue ingress.

infra-jen: attempted manual node create in us-east-2: `cloudctl compute create --type a100 --count 8 --zone us-east-2` -> cloud returned RateLimitExceeded. Trying us-west-1 and us-central as fallback. Cross-region node creation in progress but queued.

eng-runtime-dan: also enabling prefix-KV-only mode for large models to avoid full-model KV replication: `feature-toggle set kv_prefix_mode=true` — this should free ~10-15% GPU memory. Rolling now.

support-maria: customers: two enterprise customers opened tickets about timeouts (SLA-sensitive). CC'ing account leads. Sending incident banner to status page: "We are investigating elevated latency and errors for hosted-api-us-east" :warning:

sre-amy: monitoring: after throttles + cpu-fallback started ~2m ago, ingress to GPU pool down ~22%, overall queue decreased by ~3.5k. p95 dropped from 4.2s to 2.8s, p99 from 11.8s to 7.6s. Still high but improving.

infra-jen: cloud region fallback returned 6 nodes in us-west-1 but they are not yet validated for serving (nv driver mismatch). Ops working on image bake + driver patch. ETA ~18-25m if no surprises.

eng-runtime-dan: enabling degraded-quality dispatch for queued requests older than 6s: will route to smaller models when latency-critical and tenant allowed. Command: `dispatch policy set --age-threshold 6s --fallback-size small` (applied).

rohit-oncall: handing off to night oncall @rohit-oncall (me) in 25m. leaving checklist: throttle map, tenants bumped, cpu-fallback active, kv_prefix_mode=true, streaming-chunking enabled, manual node create attempted. Anyone else to add?

eng-product-liz: notifying impacted customers via account leads. We should track regression tests for quality drop for those on fallback models; create post-incident eval.

sre-amy: agree. next steps: 1) keep throttles until autoscaler recovers or manual nodes online; 2) validate fallback quality with sample prompt set; 3) follow up with cloud-provider for rate-limit increase request (ticket raised).

infra-jen: cloud ticket opened: #CLOUD-9981 for elevated creation rate. Also filing driver bake ticket #OPS-4321 for us-west image fix.

support-maria: error-rate trending down to 3.1% after actions. Gateways still returning occasional 502s from older nodes. Will keep monitoring and update status page.

sre-amy: moving thread to incident channel and starting incident doc. Handing command/control to rohit-oncall when I step out for brief. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

rohit-oncall: ack. I'll maintain watch, escalate if queue >10k or p99 >9s. Adding follow-ups: - verify fallback model outputs against customer QA sets - request reserved capacity offer for top enterprise tenants - postmortem owners: eng-runtime-dan, infra-jen, support-maria.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] queue reduced to 9,400, p95=2.5s, p99=6.9s, active_gpu_nodes=29, desired=50, cloud_rate_limit_errors=183 (5m).
